description: CiteGuard v2.1 evaluation set. Small and NOT statistically meaningful; use for regression tracking only.

label_provenance.identification: Gold identifiers are the DOI / arXiv id printed in each bibliography entry of the test manuscript, checked by the agent against the entry text; entries without a printed identifier are labelled by title (gold_title). The 'doi_stripped' variants remove the printed DOI so the gold identifier must be recovered from title/authors/year.
label_provenance.decomposition: Sentences S1-S11 are the cited sentences of the test manuscript; they were inspected while developing the splitter (development set, results are optimistic). Sentences H1-H12 were written by the agent after development as a held-out sanity check. All labels were assigned by the agent, not by an independent human annotator.
label_provenance.support: Real-paper positives were labelled by the agent from the cited works' abstracts and the retrieved passages; negatives are cross-paired controls (a claim checked against the full text of a cited work from an unrelated topic cluster in the same bibliography), which are reliably unsupported without reading the whole source. Labels marked 'uncertain' are excluded from metrics.
